name: bdd2pw
description: Scaffold runnable Playwright TypeScript tests from your Gherkin .feature files. Right-click a feature, get POMs + specs ready to run.

commands.title: bdd2pw: Scaffold Playwright tests from this feature
bdd2pw: Scaffold all .feature files in folder
bdd2pw: Open BDD_REVIEW.md from last run
bdd2pw: Propose deterministic rules from LLM candidates
bdd2pw: Toggle a domain rule pack

bdd2pw.anthropicApiKey.markdownDescription: Anthropic API key for the LLM fallback. Leave empty to disable the fallback and run rule-only. **Keep this out of settings.json that gets committed — store it in your user settings instead.**

bdd2pw.governanceUrl.description: ai-governance sidecar URL. Used to sanitize LLM prompts before they leave your machine.

bdd2pw.skipGovernance.markdownDescription: **For development only.** Skip the governance sidecar's `/sanitize` step. Production runs MUST leave this off.

bdd2pw.maxLlmCalls.description: Maximum LLM fallback calls per scaffold. Steps beyond the budget land as TODOs.

bdd2pw.outputRepo.description: Absolute path to write scaffolded Playwright project into. Leave empty to use a sibling directory next to the .feature file.

bdd2pw.baseUrl.description: Default base URL for page discovery. Can be overridden per-run from the sidebar.

bdd2pw.pomClassName.description: Default POM class name to generate. Override per-run from the sidebar.

bdd2pw.selfHealing.description: Wrap emitted locators in healOrThrow() for runtime self-healing (v1.1+ bdd2pw feature).

bdd2pw.noDiscovery.description: Skip live page discovery. Useful when the target URL isn't reachable or you only want rule-based steps.

bdd2pw.domains.markdownDescription: Opt-in domain rule packs (v3.4.0 + v3.8.0). Each pack adds ~20 regex rules covering the named industry's common Gherkin dialects. Empty = no packs (byte-stable behaviour). Combine freely — e.g. `["banking", "retail"]` activates both.

bdd2pw.useBatching.markdownDescription: v3.5.0 — per-scenario LLM batching. When **true**, a scenario with N unmatched steps fires one provider call instead of N (75%+ cost reduction). Flip to `false` only if a provider hits a per-prompt token limit on large batches or you need strict 1:1 call accounting.

bdd2pw.diagnostics.markdownDescription: v3.6.0 — rule-trace diagnostics in `BDD_REVIEW.md`. When **true**, every warning step gets a 'Rule trace' block listing the top-3 nearest rules with their patterns. Helps you see exactly what to add as a new rule. Off by default — the trace pollutes the report when you don't need it.

bdd2pw.merge.markdownDescription: v3.2.0 — idempotent regeneration with user-block preservation. When **true**, existing specs are scanned for `// bdd2pw:user-block id="..."` sections and those blocks survive the regen. Off by default — existing behavior is overwrite.

bdd2pw.dependencyStrategy.markdownDescription: v3.2.0 — how to render emitted devDependency versions. `caret` (default) emits `^1.45.0` style. `exact` strips the `^` so the consuming project pins to exact versions.

bdd2pw.metaSidecar.markdownDescription: v3.2.0 — write `<spec-stem>.spec.meta.json` alongside each spec describing every step's intent / locator / assertion. Useful for downstream tools (visual regression, defect analysis, self-healing) that want to consume bdd2pw's semantic understanding without re-parsing TS.

bdd2pw.stepHooks.markdownDescription: v3.1.0 + v3.3.0 — opt-in step hook callouts. When **true**, every `test.step` body calls `globalThis.__bdd2pwHooks?.beforeStep?.(testInfo, title, {page})` / `afterStep?.(...)` so consumers can take per-step screenshots, save DOM, attach evidence, etc. Optional-chained — consumers who don't set the hook see no behavior change.

bdd2pw.stepMarkers.markdownDescription: v3.1.0 — opt-in step boundary markers. When **true**, each `test.step` is bracketed by `// bdd2pw:step-open id="NNNN" title="..."` and `// bdd2pw:step-close id="NNNN"` comments. Lets post-processors slice the source on stable strings instead of brace counting.
